verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an app like this, but the evidence shows no user-definable rule engine. Automatic daily local backups are a fixed built-in behavior, not user-defined rules. The CLI, the 'script a workflow' remark and enteauth:// search deep links are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
